sentences.text:
Abinash Bhagat @ Abinash Kumar Bhagat vs The State Of
Jharkhand & Anr on 12 September, 2024

Author: Ratnaker Bhengra
Bench: Ratnaker Bhengra
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 Cr. Revision No. 1004 of 2022
Abinash Bhagat @ Abinash Kumar Bhagat, son of late Krishna Mohan Bhagat, resident of
village Tulsikitta, Pathargama, Near Sbi Bank , Po and Ps Pathargama, Distt. Godda
 .. .. ..Petitione
 --Versus--
The State of Jharkhand & Anr. .. ..Respondents
 ---------
Coram: Honble Mr. Justice Ratnaker Bhengra
---------
For the Petitioner : Ms. Vani Kumari, Advocate For the Respondent : Mr. S.K. Sinha, App
10/Dated: 12-09-2024 Ia No. 3797 of 2024 The present interlocutory application has been filed on
behalf of petitioner for grant of bail during pendency of the criminal revision.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner has surrendered before the learned court below on 5.3.2024 and before trial he was in custody from 22.7.2013 to 5.10.2013 about two months fourteen days and therefore he has completed about eight months out of one year of imposed sentence.
She has further submitted that there is no injury report on record.
No independent witness has been examined.
There is no material exhibit to prove the charges of demand and assault.

The learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer made in the present interlocutory application and has submitted that conviction is under section 498A IPC Having heard the learned counsels for the parties, having gone through the records of the case, considering the period of custody already spent by the petitioner and in the facts and circumstances of the case, the petitioner,
namely-above, is ordered to be released on bail, during pendency of this criminal revision, on executing bail bond of Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned ACJM, Pakur in PCR Case No. 268 of 2011, TR No. 48 of 2021.
Accordingly, I.A. No. 3797 of 2024 stands allowed and disposed of.
(Ratnaker Bhengra, J.) KNR Abinash Bhagat @ Abinash Kumar Bhagat vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28526962/
